authority_boundary: Exact visible text is preserved for grounding; all other fields are research annotations and are not source wording.
claim_relevant_visible_text: Samsung has begun sampling its HBM3E 12H to customers and mass production is slated for the first half of this year.
precision_guard: Customer sampling is an observed sample-delivery state. First-half mass production is a forward-looking plan at this vintage, not proof that HBM3E 12H had entered mass production or completed any named platform qualification.
researcher_paraphrase: Samsung said HBM3E 12H samples had begun going to customers while mass production was planned for 1H 2024.
